description:
Search the public SWATGenX example-model catalog (built SWAT+ models for USGS gauges and
    HUC outlets across the conterminous US). Filter by two-letter `state`, `calibrated_only`
    (alias `calibrated`), and channel-count bounds. A model counts as calibrated only when the
    website shows it as calibrated (its calibration tier is advertised); a failed or
    below-satisfactory run does not. Returns model id (site_no), state, size, the calibration
    tier, and — when present — the headline calibration daily NSE.
name: search_swat_models
title: Search SWAT+ example models
